name: Parfait Sucreal
original_name: パルフェ・シュクレール
source:
A witch apprentice who inherited the "Black Cat Magic Shop" from her deceased mother. She is a third-year high school student at Flor Hermos Magic Academy. Parfait's father was a court mage, but her died when Parfait was just one year old. Despite that, Parfait has a cheerful disposition. She is always energetic, kind and honest. She never doubts people, while being too friendly towards anyone she meets.
